mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.grade, t.week_start, t.status, t.current_version_id, cv.version AS current_version, t.published_version_id, pv.version AS published_version, t.review_version_id, rv.version AS review_version, t.created_by, t.published_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM weekly_theme t JOIN weekly_theme_version cv ON cv.id = t.current_version_id LEFT JOIN weekly_theme_version pv ON pv.id = t.published_version_id LEFT JOIN weekly_theme_version rv ON rv.id = t.review_version_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF t
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme WHERE id <> #{id} AND grade = #{grade} AND week_start = #{weekStart} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' )
SELECT id, version, title, intro FROM weekly_theme_version WHERE id = #{versionId}

SELECT d.day_of_week, d.mission_id, v.title, v.thinking_type FROM weekly_theme_day d JOIN mission m ON m.id = d.mission_id JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = COALESCE(m.published_version_id, m.current_version_id) WHERE d.theme_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY d.day_of_week
SELECT count(*) FROM mission WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_theme (id, grade, week_start, status, current_version_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{grade}, #{weekStart}, #{status}, #{versionId}, #{createdBy}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO weekly_theme_version (id, theme_id, version, title, intro, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{themeId}, #{version}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{createdBy}, #{now})
INSERT INTO weekly_theme_day (theme_version_id, day_of_week, mission_id) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{missionId})
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_theme SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE weekly_theme SET status = #{status}, review_version_id = current_version_id, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, mission_id, theme_id, context, status, started_at, finished_at, completed_at FROM attempt WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND theme_week_start = #{weekStart} ORDER BY started_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_review_view (student_id, week_start, theme_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{weekStart}, #{themeId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (student_id, week_start) DO NOTHING
